meta.quantisation: embed output rounded to uint8 (PNG-equivalent) before every metric and every detection
meta.msssim: 5-scale product of win-7 SSIM with Wang weights (approximation: full SSIM per scale, not CS-only terms)
meta.flat_metric: max/mean |delta| (8-bit, max over RGB) over pixels whose 7x7 local std of the ORIGINAL luma < 2/255
